name: Trade Security Identification Query Criteria 3
definition: Specifies the query criteria related to securities.

Operator.name: Operator
Operator.definition: Specifies the AND/OR operators as query criteria.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the product through ISIN or AII.

ContractType.name: Contract Type
ContractType.definition: Classification of information according to contract type.

ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN). A numbering system designed by the United Nation's International Organisation for Standardisation (ISO). The ISIN is composed of a 2-character prefix representing the country of issue, followed by the national security number (if one exists), and a check digit. Each country has a national numbering agency that assigns ISIN numbers for securities in that country.

UniqueProductIdentifier.name: Unique Product Identifier
UniqueProductIdentifier.definition: Identification of the product through a unique product identifier.

UnderlyingInstrumentIdentification.name: Underlying Instrument Identification
UnderlyingInstrumentIdentification.definition: Unique identification to identify the direct underlying instrument based on its type.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
